title: Vegetable Image Classification App
tagline: A vegetable image recognition app that identifies 15 produce categories from uploaded photos and presents clear confidence results.
taglineId: Aplikasi pengenalan gambar sayuran yang mengidentifikasi 15 kategori produk dari foto yang diunggah dan menyajikan hasil confidence yang jelas.
seoDescription: I built a vegetable image classification app that recognizes produce categories from uploaded photos with confidence scores.
features: Simple image upload with drag-and-drop or file browse.
Primary prediction and confidence score that are easy to understand.
Recognized class catalog so users know the model scope.
Clean responsive UI for a complete ML demo experience.
featuresId: Upload gambar sederhana dengan drag-and-drop atau browse file.
Prediksi utama dan skor confidence yang mudah dipahami.
Katalog kelas yang dikenali sehingga pengguna tahu cakupan model.
UI responsif yang rapi untuk pengalaman demo ML yang lengkap.
impact: Makes vegetable type identification from photos quick and easy.
Builds user trust through confidence scores and Top-5 predictions.
Shows a complete path from TensorFlow model training to web inference.
impactId: Membuat identifikasi jenis sayuran dari foto menjadi cepat dan mudah.
Membangun kepercayaan pengguna melalui skor confidence dan prediksi Top-5.
Menunjukkan alur lengkap dari pelatihan model TensorFlow hingga inferensi web.

collaboration.label: Individual
contributions: Trained the vegetable image classification model.
Built the image-classification pipeline for upload, prediction, and confidence output.
Implemented the Streamlit UI with confidence scores and Top-5 predictions.
contributionsId: Membangun pipeline klasifikasi gambar untuk upload, prediksi, dan output confidence.
Mengimplementasikan UI Streamlit dengan skor confidence dan prediksi Top-5.
